method: Every pass-vs-gold disagreement re-opened on the vendor page by the reviewer; gold edited only when the page contradicts it.

rulings.quote: You'll get access to a free developer environment
Start free trial ... No credit card required
v3 API uses API keys; Basic not supported
App review only applies to App Store distribution; custom apps on free dev stores need none
MCP integration is a developer preview -> beta
'other' is not a valid api_type value (schema violation)
Legacy API keys use HTTP Digest -> 'other' is a valid extra method
Access to the Premium GraphQL APIs is available only to partners on the Silver, Gold, and Platinum tiers
Starter: 5 connections max; card required moving to Core -> free for dev, paid for a multi-tenant toolkit
PB-Token key provisioned by account manager -> api_key
Sandbox access is tied to the Marketplace Developer account ... provisioned immediately; sandbox can generate PITs. End users still need a paid plan.
